High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble Timer API.

Provides app timer functionality for scheduling callbacks.

Imports

../ffi, ../ffi/managed

Types

TimerHandle = object
Managed handle for AppTimer. Note: Timers are automatically destroyed by the system after they fire. This handle allows canceling a pending timer via RAII.
